title: record page: a synthesized page that falls back to page tabs may still draw the approval-lock band once per details part
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #35253 dev (os-dev-report 7007256219, PR #35478 Acceptance notes), read in code and not driven live. L1-a named it as owed (ACCEPT 7007712812). It is a follow-up of #35253 and is nested under it.
Reader: `domain:ui` (plugin-detail synthesized record page). Suggested grade: p3 (no real object measured; the laid-out page, which is the common case, is fixed by #35478).
Dedupe: `approval band page tabs`, `locked for approval twice`, `lock chip once tabs`. Only #35253 matches, and it covers the laid-out page.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：极少数无法按栏布局、退回页签形式的系统默认记录页，审批锁定标识可能仍显示多次。
- 为什么做：前一张卡只修好了按栏布局的默认页，这是同一问题的剩余情形。
- 出错会怎样：只影响标识显示次数，锁定规则不变；撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts (read in code at PR #35478 head `0122020a`, not measured on a real object)

- #35478 makes only the first `record:details` part draw the approval band, through a module-internal context that `RecordPageColumns` sets to false on every later part.
- When the synthesized page cannot be laid out (`buildDefaultPageColumns` returns null), the host draws its `page:tabs` strip instead, which is not drawn through `RecordPageColumns`, so each details part reads the default `true` and draws its own band.

A related case, worth measuring first (L1-a): if the first details part draws no `DetailView` body (for example every section is empty and folded), the band is suppressed on every later part, so a page could show no band at all. Measure whether that is reachable before deciding it is real.

## Ask

Measure whether any object reaches the `page:tabs` fallback with more than one details part while approval-locked. If it does, apply #35478's rule there (one band per page), with pins for the tabs fallback and CONTROLs for a single part. Also measure the empty-first-part case above and pin whichever answer holds. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` expected.

⛔ Not a claim.
